period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own unaudited interim financial statement PDF for this quarter, downloaded from the bank's live website (tblbd.com/about-us/financial-statements). SOLO / Bank-only basis (same basis as this dataset's main Q4/annual series): this source document explicitly separates a 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' section (Bank-only / Solo) from a separate 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' section earlier in the same PDF; the SOLO section is the one used here -- confirmed by exact match between this PDF's own 31-Dec-2015 comparative column and this dataset's stored 2015_Q4.json total_assets. No basis mismatch with this bank's main series (contrast with the CONSOLIDATED-basis 2017-2025 quarters sourced from the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table). Balance-sheet items are the period-end snapshot (unaudited); income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year (the source's own column header reads e.g. '1 January to <quarter-end date>'), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix. Balance-sheet identity (assets = liabilities + equity) and Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses = Profit Before Provision both verified exactly against this source.
